Title: Register new customer with valid unique data
Steps: Preconditions: Browser on Toolshop home; email not already registered. 1) Open Sign in -> Register (/auth/register). 2) Enter valid First name, Last name, DOB (age 18-75), Address, Postcode, City, State, Country, Phone. 3) Enter unique Email and strong Password (8+ chars, upper, lower, number, symbol). 4) Submit registration.
Expected Result: Account is created; user can proceed to login (or is redirected); no validation errors.

Title: Login with valid credentials establishes session
Steps: Preconditions: Registered customer exists (TC-01 user or seeded customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01). 1) Open Sign in (/auth/login). 2) Enter valid email and password. 3) Submit login. 4) Open My account / profile.
Expected Result: User is authenticated; account/profile shows correct name/email; session persists on navigation.

Title: Search returns matching products by keyword
Steps: Preconditions: Home page loaded; catalog has products (e.g. hammer or pliers). 1) From home, enter a known product keyword in Search. 2) Submit / apply search. 3) Open one result product detail.
Expected Result: Results list shows products whose names match the query; PDP shows name, price, and stock consistently with the listing.

Title: Update cart quantity recalculates line total
Steps: Preconditions: User can add to cart; at least one in-stock product available. 1) Open an in-stock product -> Add to cart (qty 1). 2) Open Cart (/cart). 3) Increase quantity to 2. 4) Observe cart line total and cart badge/count.
Expected Result: Quantity shows 2; line total = unit price x 2; cart badge/count reflects updated quantity; no stale totals.

Title: COD checkout requires Confirm clicked twice
Steps: Preconditions: User logged in; cart has >=1 in-stock item; valid billing address (city belongs to selected country). 1) From cart, proceed to Checkout (/checkout). 2) Enter/confirm billing address. 3) Select payment method Cash on Delivery. 4) Click Confirm once. 5) Verify invoice ID is not yet shown / order not finalized. 6) Click Confirm a second time.
Expected Result: After 1st Confirm: payment/check proceeds but no invoice ID yet. After 2nd Confirm: order completes; payment success shown; invoice ID is generated and displayed.

Title: Invoice ID visible after double Confirm and listed in account
Steps: Preconditions: Logged-in user; cart with item; valid address; ready for COD order. 1) Complete checkout with Cash on Delivery. 2) Click Confirm (1st) - note no invoice ID yet. 3) Click Confirm (2nd) - capture displayed invoice ID / invoice number. 4) Navigate to My account -> Invoices (/account/invoices). 5) Locate the new invoice; open details (and download PDF if available).
Expected Result: Invoice ID appears only after the second Confirm. Same invoice number appears under Account Invoices with matching line items/totals. PDF status reaches COMPLETED when download is offered.

Title: API checkout rejects payload missing cart_id or billing_street
Steps: Preconditions: Valid Bearer token; cart with >=1 item; known valid billing/payment baseline fields. 1) POST /users/login -> capture access_token. 2) POST /carts -> add in-stock product -> capture cart_id. 3) Variant A: POST /invoices omitting cart_id (other required fields present). 4) Variant B: POST /invoices with valid cart_id omitting billing_street. 5) Optionally retry each variant with empty string for the omitted field.
Expected Result: Both variants return 4xx (typically 422) with field-level errors. No new invoice/invoice_number is created. Existing cart remains uncleared. Account invoice list count unchanged for this attempt.

Title: Cart quantity boundary - update item count to 0 or negative values
Steps: Preconditions: Cart exists with one in-stock product at quantity >= 1; record cart_id, product_id, line quantity, and line total. 1) API zero: PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity with quantity 0. 2) API negative: same endpoint with quantity -1 (optionally -999). 3) GET /carts/{cartId} and note line quantity/totals after each attempt. 4) UI: On /cart attempt quantity 0 or negative via control/input. 5) Confirm cart badge/count does not show negative or absurd values.
Expected Result: Zero/negative updates are rejected (4xx/422 or UI validation) or, if zero removes the line, totals stay >= 0 — never negative quantity or total. Cart state consistent on refresh. No checkout on invalid negative-qty cart.
